title: AI-assisted document drafting chat (ANDS Studio dossier builder)
walkthrough:
You are in "ANDS Studio", working inside a dossier. A top bar shows the product name, five module tabs ("M1" through "M5") with status dots, and chips for "Application Viewer", "Audit", "Portfolio", and "Journey". The screen is three columns: a left rail listing eCTD sections with status glyphs and "req"/"opt" badges, a centre section panel, and a right rail with progress and readiness flags ("Documents", "Fee", "Valid eCTD").

Clicking a section opens its panel: an eyebrow line like "Module 1 · Section 1.2.1", the section title, and a guidance box headed "What Health Canada needs here" with a "Health Canada guidance ↗" link. Below sits an action tab bar: "⬆ Upload", "✦ Author in-app", and "⊘ Mark N/A".

Choosing "✦ Author in-app" on an AI-draftable section reveals a second toggle: "💬 Draft with AI" (the default) versus "✦ Sample & edit". Nothing in the section tree marks which sections support AI drafting — you discover it only after opening a section and clicking "✦ Author in-app".

The chat panel opens with a note that the assistant "will ask for any details it needs instead of leaving blanks" and that nothing is saved until you click "Use this draft". The empty thread reads "Tell it about the submission to get started". You type into a text box with the placeholder "e.g. Sponsor is Acme Pharma Inc., contact regulatory@acme.example" and press "Send" (or Enter); the button reads "Thinking…" while the reply streams in token by token as chat bubbles.

Once a reply finishes, a button "Use this draft →" appears ("Saving…" while it works). Saving shows no visible confirmation banner — the confirmation ("saved as an AI-assisted draft — provenance is recorded in the audit trail") is announced only to screen readers. Visually, an attached-document row appears above the tabs: a 💬 icon, filename, size, an md5 checksum prefix, a "Download" link, and a provenance badge reading "AI-assisted — review before filing", whose hover tooltip says the draft was "Drafted interactively with the AI assistant under your direction" and should be reviewed against Health Canada guidance. Checking the draft against requirements means switching to "✦ Sample & edit" and clicking "Review vs Health Canada", which lists findings ("✗" errors, "⚠" warnings) with suggested edits.

If the backend LLM key is missing, the chat shows: "AI drafting isn't set up yet (no GROQ_API_KEY). Use the standard \"Author\" button below instead, or ask an admin to configure it."
